description_en: Hands off a conversation to a human agent
description_zh: 切换真人客服接管模式
kebab_example: aliyun ice takeover-ai-agent-call --instance-id 39f8e0bc005e4f309379701645f40000 --human-agent-user-id uid2 --require-token false --region cn-hangzhou
name: TakeoverAIAgentCall

parameters.help_en: The ID of the AI agent that will be taken over
parameters.help_zh:
智能体实例 ID。

InstanceId为智能体实例启动成功后，返回的唯一的Id。启动智能体接口，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2846201.html、https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2846209.html
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the human agent that will take over the AI agent (UserId in ARTC). If you do not specify this parameter, it is automatically generated and returned
parameters.help_zh: 将要接管的真人客服的 RTC UserId。不填写则自动生成并返回
parameters.name: human_agent_user_id

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to return the ARTC token. Default value: false
parameters.help_zh: 是否需要返回RTC入会Token，默认false
parameters.name: require_token
